entries.title: Integral Bifurcated Landing Stair
entries.description: One newly authored complete grounded T-plan stone stair solid. A central lower approach rises into a full shared landing; two opposed upper flights branch left and right to two separate raised terminals. The material boundary is one closed connected editable mesh with no interior coincident cell faces. Unlike the old single-route straight, quarter-turn and returning parallel flights, its ascent route branches at the landing from one low approach into two upper directions. This is not extra repeated old steps or changed height, colour or tread count. Native metres, horizontal bounds-centred ground sole, two opaque constant PBR materials. One static architecture module, zero scenes. No handrails, supporting upper floor, host wall, pedestrian navigation, accessibility, load, code compliance, installation or safety guarantee.

entries.title: Stepped Outdoor Outcrop Viewpoint
entries.description: One static outdoor photography viewpoint scene from the original outdoor-camera-position program, one scene and zero new independent models. Three whole qualified original assets are preserved: a tripod box camera on a raised stone-like terrace, its open recessed-insert camera bag separately beside it, and a complete fractured natural outcrop on the lower terrain to the right. Only the complete camera turns exactly 90 degrees toward the outcrop; all old meshes, raw GLB geometry, normals, internal nodes and full per-face PBR remain unchanged at unit scale. A single continuous scene-only ground solid provides the raised camera and bag terrace, three intermediate descent treads and broad lower rock bed. Complete finite original feet and bag bottom sit within the upper horizontal terrace; the complete rock sole is on the lower bed. This is an outdoor high-low camera position with an actual whole terrain subject, not a rearranged portrait backdrop or still-life tabletop set. The bag remains empty; neither camera nor lens is inserted into its recesses. No optical targeting accuracy, camera image capture, weather protection, adjustable camera mount, path clearance certification, pedestrian accessibility, safe footing, structural strength or safety suitability is claimed.

entries.title: Arching Pinnate-Crown Desert Palm
entries.description: One original static pinnate-crown desert palm. A gently bent tapering trunk has integral shallow ring-scar bands and a compact swollen terminal crown. Eight unequal long arching fronds spread and droop from the crown; each has a whole curved rachis with fourteen separate narrow folded pinnae and a terminal blade. The open gaps run along the full leaf axes rather than forming the radial clefts of a fused fan palm. All numeric trunk and leaf paths are newly authored; no old fern, palm mesh or external plant is imported or scaled. One complete tree, not a color, leaf-count or size variant. Static stylized vegetation only, no species-accuracy, fruit, growth, wind animation, rooting mechanics or stability claim.

entries.title: Static Open-Hood Long-Raincoat Worker
entries.description: One newly authored anonymous static outdoor worker display in a knee-length hooded raincoat. A complete thick flared coat has true inner walls, open lower hem and neck rim; a separate thick hood has an actual forward face aperture and closed back shell. Two complete long thick sleeves have genuine cuff apertures around fixed glove roots. A narrow full front placket follows the coat profile. One new shaped anonymous head uses integral nose and small eye/mouth material regions, while two whole trouser legs descend to two complete tall flat-ground boots. All numerical geometry is new, not the old apron worker recoloured or a scarecrow with a changed hat. Five opaque untextured matte PBR materials; separate closed bodies have intentionally embedded fixed clothing/body joins, not a seamless unified skin. Metres, native Z up, front -Y and full horizontal-bounds-centred ground origin. One whole dressed figure and zero scenes or outfit variants. Static artistic appearance only, no real identity, precise anatomy, interchangeable clothing, actual garment fit, waterproofing, protection, occupation certification, motion, rig, cloth simulation, comfort, manufacture or safety claim.

entries.title: Paired Unequal Winged Samara
entries.description: One original whole stylised paired winged tree fruit. Two unequal complete seed-and-wing bodies join at their narrow basal end and diverge in a V: each plump rounded nucleus continuously narrows into a long finite thin blade that broadens distally and tapers again to a small tip. Kernel and wing share every connecting section within one closed mesh; no separate leaf, old bean, aircraft part or texture card is attached. Both genuine thick nuclei have small ground soles, while the blades gently lift and fold. Three opaque matte dry-plant PBR roles with no textures. Two meshes form one prop, zero scenes or extra seed/wing assets. Metres, Z up, actual horizontal bounds-centred. Static stylised samara-like appearance only, no exact tree species, botanical identification, flight/aerodynamics, seed dispersal, growth, germination, ecology or real-world use claim.

entries.title: Offset Landing and Access-Tower Court
entries.description: One static spacebase landing-service court assembled from two complete qualified original facilities: a broad octagonal well-and-outlet landing platform on the left and a separate fixed caged access-lift tower offset to the rear-right. The landing ramp reaches a ground-level dogleg band aimed toward the tower front, while the front low outlet faces a separate empty apron. The tower keeps its original fixed elevated car and forward trough, at a different height from the landing field: these are deliberately not claimed to be a connected upper bridge or a compatible docking system. All original meshes, directed triangles, normal buffers, internal node transforms and material dictionaries remain intact at unit scale and unchanged pose. A low scene-only connected floor with same-surface path materials is the only new geometry. This landing-field / lower-outlet clearance / offset service-access relation differs from the earlier junction with solar array and sampling rover forecourt. One scene, zero new independent models, two complete instances of two accepted models. No new leg, ramp, tower, vehicle, solar array or repeated prop is counted. Static art only: no real landing, exhaust clearance, evacuation, boarding accessibility, docking compatibility, elevator function, loading, thermal behaviour, navigation, operational workflow, engineering or safety claim.

entries.title: Opposed-Wall Timber Flying Shore
entries.description: One newly authored complete static opposed-wall timber flying-shore appearance for the original ruins/repair temporary-support direction. Two broad vertical wall-bearing plates face each other across an open span. A full horizontal elevated strut connects their inner faces; four whole upper/lower rakers have vertical outer ends and horizontal inner ends, joining those plates to the two sides of the central strut. Two fixed thick metal-coloured cheek plates close the central joint on its front and rear. The lower middle span stays open, with no ground sole or central floor post. This is not the old one-sided ground-raking frame doubled or an arch form with extra posts: the complete bilateral elevated support arrangement is newly authored. Nine closed editable solids and three opaque constant PBR materials, native metres, horizontal bounds-centred origin at the wall plates lowest ends. The absent host walls are intentional; the preview datum does not certify freestanding stability or installation. One model, zero scenes. No actual building, damage simulation, working joint, pressure/load transfer, construction method, dimensions fit, structural adequacy or safety guarantee.

entries.title: Toy Shelf Display and Checkout Shop
entries.description: One static toy-shop display scene, one scene and zero new independent models. Five complete original qualified assets are preserved at unit scale: freestanding pierced A-frame bookcase, a wooden toy car on its real lowest shelf tray, a seated fabric bear on a low scene-only display plinth, an open worktable and a complete open-till register on its actual tabletop. Only the whole wooden car turns exactly 90 degrees to present its broad grip-window side; other original poses remain unchanged. A single continuous floor/plinth solid provides the low bear display and open front aisle. Car wheel soles fit inside the actual shelf floor, below the next full shelf; the register footprint lies inside the complete tabletop, and all unrelated whole objects remain separated. This is retail display and checkout staging, not the earlier play-kitchen and floor-play arrangement. Original raw GLB vertex/normal payloads, internal nodes, every full component and per-face solid PBR are retained, not resized toys or extracted shelf parts. No labels, price text, money, customers, child scale, toy age suitability, payment function, merchandise protection, load capacity, shelving stability, accessibility or safety certification is claimed.

entries.title: Static Long-Foot Tail-Resting Kangaroo
entries.description: One original stylised fixed kangaroo-like animal with an ascending continuous torso and long neck, small elongated head and tapered muzzle, two upright pointed thick ears, two short raised forearms and two strongly developed hind limbs. Each hind limb is one closed continuous long ground foot, narrow hock, forward knee and broad thigh, not a separate enlarged rabbit paw. One long thick tapering rear tail has genuine finite ground-contact facets and completes the three-part resting support silhouette. New whole proportions and coordinates, no old seated rabbit, antlered deer, frog or robot mesh reused. Pale belly and ear regions belong to the full surfaces; small dark eyes are seated separate bodies and the nose is an integral muzzle cap. Three opaque constant matte PBR materials, metres, native Z up, head/front -Y and whole horizontal bounds-centred ground origin. Separate closed components use intentionally embedded fixed joins. One whole prop, zero scenes, no extra pose or juvenile. Artistic exterior only: no precise species or anatomy, sex/pouch/offspring, gait, jumping, balance, locomotion, biological behaviour, rig, physical simulation, welfare, manufacture or safety claim.

entries.title: Fixed Open-Feed Twin-Roll Crusher
entries.description: One original complete static ore-processing machine appearance with a broad open feed hopper, two transverse solid rolls opposed across a real narrow central gap, and a separate open tapered discharge funnel below. Each whole roll has integral stepped shoulders and two solid journals seated in four actual bored bearing bodies. Two grounded inverted-U end frames carry the bearings, four short hopper stanchions and the discharge flange. Fourteen closed editable meshes and four opaque constant untextured PBR materials. The whole upper-feed / opposed-roll nip / lower-outlet arrangement is the structural distinction: not just two cylinders, old corrugated V jaws made round, more vertical stamps, or a twin-helical robot with its body removed. No imported old geometry, hopper payload, motor, gear train, guards, belt, particles or separately counted parts. One whole prop, no scene. Metres, native Z up, front -Y, complete horizontal bounds centred and actual four foot soles at Z0. Static art only: no working rotation, synchronization, crushing, material feed, product size, throughput, machinery compatibility, maintenance access, manufacture, installation, structural loading, workplace protection or safety claim. Visible exposed fixed parts are not a safe real-machine design or instructions.
